correctness.rationale: PASS: For each proper S subset of n Bernoulli rounds, the moment equations E(prod_(i in S)B_i)=prod p_i have rank 2^n-1, giving one affine parity atom coordinate q_b+(-1)^(n-|b|)*theta. Nonnegativity is precisely -alpha<=theta<=beta. In CE the -z_y expectation is theta-invariant. Its mixed forward difference equals integral of distinct-index derivative of logsumexp, which is (-1)^(n-1)(n-1)! times strictly positive product of softmax probabilities; hence unique theta endpoint by n parity, invariant in y. Fair p=1/2 endpoint supported on even parity and symmetric h asymptotic gain h/2^n+O(1) follow exactly by binomial difference. Independently computed 50 random higher-dimensional cases for proper-subset constraints and endpoint sign, and n=3 h=4 gain 0.25014236686591174. Finite examples do not establish general calculus or rank proof.

value.rationale: PASS: Identifies a mathematically sharp way higher-order dependence changes a standard nonlinear loss while all lower-order Bernoulli joint distributions, means and covariances are preserved. Exact n-way mixed derivative gives a universal label-independent optimizer and quantifiable risk gap; this is a useful natural risk invariant beyond known probability coupling geometry, with no speculative actual floating point implementation guarantee.

limitations: Only simultaneous one-stage output-logit quantization, all proper subcollections independent, interior Bernoulli parameters and positive bins.
No claim of operation-level sequential martingale correctness, accuracy on trained models or top-1 prediction improvement.
